correctness.rationale: Assuming precisely the five exhaustive Kazemifard–Tafazolian wild-boundary families for characteristic 2 and subgroup order 2g, Deuring–Shafarevich gives gamma=(r-1) for an Artin–Schreier rational-base double cover with r reduced poles: y^2+y=c(x^m+x^-m) has r=2 and gamma=1. The one-wild-branch C4 and C12 cyclic-four covers of genus 2/6 each have one totally ramified short orbit and quotient P1, hence gamma-1=-4+3=-1. In genus3, the intermediate w^3=z(z-1) equals a single-pole AS curve z^2+z=w^3, gamma(Y)=0; its further AS cover has one pole, gamma(C)=0. For genus15, the explicit Kummer change u=w^6/[z(z-1)^2], v=w/u gives u^5=z, v^3=z-1, hence genus4 Y: v^3=u^5-1. Four regular differentials have Cartier chain omega2 -> omega0 -> omega3 -> 0, omega1 -> 0, so the semilinear Cartier operator is nilpotent and gamma(Y)=0. Its one-pole double cover has rank 0. Independently counted Y(F_(2^r)) as 3,5,9,9 for r=1..4 and verified Cartier matrix C^2 nonzero, C^3 zero. The all-family quantifier depends on completeness of the source classification, whose full text was inaccessible.
